newsitem.title: POLAND: Petro Bank to move some departments.
newsitem.headline: Petro Bank to move some departments.

text.p: Polish bank LG Petro Bank SA will move its international banking, corporate banking, trade finance and brokerage departments to Warsaw from Lodz, the bank's acting president said on Wednesday.
Dong-Chang Park told Reuters that such departments would be located at a new branch in Warsaw and not be developed in Lodz.

"In our headquarters in Lodz we only plan to add a retail banking department. The reason is that almost all of the biggest customers, especially export-import companies, are based in Warsaw," he said.
Some Polish newspapers had earlier speculated that the bank, in which South Korean LG Group holds 54 percent of shares, was moving its headquarters to Warsaw.

Dong-Chang Park also said bank president Dong-Soo Choi and his deputy Boguslaw Grabowski had been dismissed last week because they could not agree on a business plan and the organisational structure of the bank.
He said new management would be appointed after the bank's shareholders meeting at the end of June.
